create_own_env: run command on terminal  python -m venv .venv
description: An end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that answers questions from PDF documents using FAISS vector search, Groq LLM, and an Open Source LLM with FastAPI support.

modules.ingestion: ingestion.ipynb - Extracts PDF content, performs chunking, generates embeddings, and creates the FAISS vector database.

question_answering.groq: Q&A_groq.ipynb - Retrieves relevant chunks from FAISS and generates answers using Groq (Llama 3.3 70B).
question_answering.opensource: Q&A_openSource_llm.ipynb - Retrieves relevant chunks from FAISS and generates answers using Google FLAN-T5.

modules.fastapi: app.py - Provides REST APIs for both Groq and Open Source LLMs.

api_endpoints.POST /opensource_chat: Generate answers using Open Source LLM
